events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Royalty
angles.copy: He's brought us some of the most iconic characters and unforgettable laughs. Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles,' but universally known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: Revolutionary Record
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that proved they could do anything. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Thirty-five years. Still unmatched. Remembering the incredible Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence continue to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965, showcasing a significant shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Game Changer
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and showed the world what pop music could truly be.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years on, his message still resonates. Remembering John Lennon, a visionary artist and advocate for peace.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: On what would have been his 80th birthday, we remember the iconic British musician and cultural innovator, David Bowie.

angles.name: Starman Forever
angles.copy: Eighty years ago, a legend was born. Celebrating the enduring artistry and influence of David Bowie on his birthday.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on what would have been his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: Ninety-two years. The voice, the moves, the legend. Happy birthday to Elvis Presley, forever the King.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, songwriter, and producer, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the architect of some of rock's most iconic riffs. Happy birthday to the one and only Jimmy Page!

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer and songwriter, Sir Rod Stewart, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: From the Faces to solo stardom, a voice that's defined generations. Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: It Must Be Love
angles.copy: Sixty-six years of ska, style, and pure British charm. Happy birthday to the inimitable Suggs from Madness!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The acclaimed British singer, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Every Time You Go Away
angles.copy: Seventy-one years of that unmistakable voice. Happy birthday to Paul Young, a true 80s icon!

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the beloved Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, on what would have been her 81st birthday. She passed away in August 2026.

angles.name: Pure Imagination
angles.copy: Eighty-one years of sparkle, song, and pure heart. On her birthday, we pay tribute to the one-of-a-kind Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Forever Love
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the man behind so many hits. Happy birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow!

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter, known for his string of 80s hits, Billy Ocean, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Seventy-seven years and still making us 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car'! Happy birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring rock's founding legends.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty was officially enshrined. Who would you induct into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer and solo artist, Mark Owen, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Fifty-five today for one of the UK's most beloved pop stars. Happy birthday to Mark Owen!

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert on the Apple Corps building in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Iconic Performance
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their final live show. A moment etched in music history!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning British singer-songwriter, drummer, and producer, Phil Collins, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Seventy-six years for a true music powerhouse. Happy birthday to the incredible Phil Collins!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: The beloved British actor, known for his roles in many romantic comedies, Hugh Grant, celebrates his 67th birthday.

angles.name: Charming Icon
angles.copy: From Notting Hill to Wonka, he's still got that charm. Happy 67th birthday to the quintessential British leading man, Hugh Grant!

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The multi-talented American singer, songwriter, and actor, Justin Timberlake, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Forty-six years for the man who brought 'SexyBack' and so much more. Happy birthday to Justin Timberlake!

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The much-loved British actor, famous for his roles as Del Boy and Jack Frost, Sir David Jason, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young for a true national treasure. Happy birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason!

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly (who would have been 90), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 96) tragically died in a plane crash, a day forever known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Gone Too Soon
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, rock and roll lost three shining stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The British pop icon, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', Rick Astley, celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Sixty-one and still Rickrolling the world! Happy birthday to the fantastic Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we celebrate the life and legacy of reggae pioneer Bob Marley.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Eighty-two years for the man who brought reggae to the world and spread a message of peace. Happy birthday to the legendary Bob Marley.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The influential American singer-songwriter, responsible for countless hits, Carole King, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Eighty-five years of songwriting genius. Happy birthday to the incredible Carole King, a true music legend!

events.title: Anniversary of Whitney Houston's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 15 years since the world lost the incomparable Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years. Still no one quite like her. Remembering the phenomenal Whitney Houston, whose voice remains timeless.
